_comment: Calibrated tail conventions per (vector, enzyme, application). Adding a new triple = one entry here + (if needed) a new TailRuleFn in lib/primer_design/vectors.py. Keys are formatted as 'vector|enzyme|application'.

pEXG2|HindIII|deletion.name: site_destroyed
pEXG2|HindIII|deletion.calibrated_against: corrected 2026-06 — old rule excl_recognition left AGCT out of left arm; P1 must span the sticky end so the PCR product aligns with bottom strand after exonuclease chewing

pEXG2|HindIII|tagging.name: site_destroyed
pEXG2|HindIII|tagging.calibrated_against: shares pEXG2|HindIII|deletion convention; junction overlap differs (see D6.4)

pBBR1MCS2|HindIII|expression.name: site_partial_AAGCT
pBBR1MCS2|HindIII|expression._geometry_note: Addgene pBBR1MCS-2 (#85168) MCS reads 5'->3' as ...SalI-ClaI-HindIII-EcoRV-EcoRI... so the empirical primer #1573's tail (10 nt left-arm + first 5 nt of AAGCTT) is the FORWARD-strand left-arm rule. P4 then uses RC of the right arm, anchored at the nick.
pBBR1MCS2|HindIII|expression.calibrated_against: PA14 lasR primer #1612 / lasB primer #1573 (working empirical set)

default|site_destroyed.name: site_destroyed
default|site_destroyed.calibrated_against: FALLBACK ONLY — used for non-calibrated triples; verification will catch mistakes
